nl: 车辆调度管理：查询有车牌号、驾驶员；表格展示车牌号、驾驶员、目的地、油卡号、油卡备注；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「油卡备注」在未填写「油卡号」时隐藏。
nlEn: Vehicle dispatch management: query by plate number and driver; the table shows plate number, driver, destination, fuel-card number, and fuel-card note; supports add, edit, and delete. In the form, "fuel-card note" is hidden while the "fuel-card number" is empty.
notes: AI-06: isHidden op=empty — 油卡号为空时隐藏油卡备注（vue2/schema）
